newsitem.title: USA: Biomune redeems some preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Biomune redeems some preferred shares.

text.p: Biomune Systems Inc said on Friday it redeemed 30 percent of its Series C preferred shares.
Biomune said repurchasing the shares "based upon the current market price would be a prudent decision in light of current events occurring within the company."

"Management believes the current suppression in the market price of Biomune's common stock has been a direct result of the perceived overhang of these preferred shares which are convertible into the company's common stock," the company said in a statement.
Biomune was trading at 1-3/32 early Friday, down 3/32 on the day and well below its 52-week high of 3-3/8.
